HOOD.headline: Stock Market Midday, Sept. 3: Stocks Rally as Treasury Yields Fall, Broadcom Falls Despite Earnings Beat
HOOD.description: U.S. stock markets rallied on September 3, 2026, as Treasury yields fell and the probability of a September rate hike decreased. Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller signaled a preference for holding rates steady unless inflation surprises emerge. The S&P 500, Dow Jones, and Nasdaq all gained over 1%, with industrials and financial services leading. Notable movers included Snowflake surging 20% on strong earnings, while Broadcom declined despite beating expectations. Nvidia gained on news

HOOD.headline: IBKR Sees 23% Y/Y Rise in Client DARTs in August 2026: What Drove It?
HOOD.description: Interactive Brokers reported a 23% year-over-year increase in client DARTs to 4.28 million in August 2026, driven by market volatility from monetary policy shifts, inflation concerns, and geopolitical tensions. The company also saw net new accounts jump 49% y/y and total accounts reach 5.46 million. Strong performance was supported by IBKR's low-cost structure, competitive rates, and efficient operations.

HOOD.headline: Is Schwab a Buy as Product Diversification Unlocks Next Growth Phase?
HOOD.description: Charles Schwab is expanding beyond traditional brokerage into wealth management, banking, lending, active trading, and crypto. The company reported 18% revenue growth to $13.6B and 41% earnings growth in H1 2026, with strong organic asset gathering of $58.1B in July. While trading at a premium valuation (7.73X tangible book vs. 3.32X industry average), improving earnings prospects and diversified revenue streams support a favorable investment case. Schwab received a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating.

SNOW.headline: Why Snowflake Stock Rocketed Higher Today
SNOW.description: Snowflake stock surged approximately 20% after delivering strong Q2 fiscal 2027 results that beat analyst expectations. The company reported $1.55B in revenue (up 35% YoY) and $0.62 adjusted EPS (up 77%), exceeding consensus estimates. Snowflake raised its full-year 2027 guidance to $6.07B and provided optimistic Q3 guidance, demonstrating that AI developments are accelerating rather than hindering its business growth.

SNOW.headline: Snowflake Inc. (SNOW) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Top Estimates
SNOW.description: Snowflake reported Q2 2026 earnings of $0.62 per share, beating consensus estimates by 37.78%, with revenues of $1.55 billion exceeding expectations by 4.91%. The company has outperformed the market by 45.8% year-to-date. However, the stock received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating due to mixed estimate revisions, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market. DocuSign is expected to report results on September 3.

SNOW.headline: ADP Brings +38K Private-Sector Jobs in August
SNOW.description: ADP reported only 38K new private-sector jobs in August, below expectations of 47K and marking the weakest tally since January. The labor market continues to show weakness, with Friday's non-farm payrolls expected to reach 53K. Major indexes opened mixed, with the Dow slightly up while the Nasdaq declined. Several companies are reporting earnings after market close.

CRCL.headline: Circle: Monopoly & Banking Charter Drive AI Growth
CRCL.description: Circle Internet Group, the largest U.S. stablecoin issuer, has received historic banking approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, making it the first stablecoin issuer with such designation. The company is expected to achieve profitability in 2026 with projected EPS growth of 338.64%, driven by expanding utility in AI micropayments and U.S. Treasury markets. Circle's regulatory advantages and near-monopoly position in stablecoins position it for significant market dominance.

CRCL.headline: Major Banks Make a Move Into Stablecoins: What Should Investors Watch?
CRCL.description: A consortium of 21 major global banks including Citigroup, Bank of America, Goldman Sachs, and Wells Fargo plans to launch a U.S. dollar-denominated stablecoin in the first half of 2027, enabled by the new GENIUS Act regulatory framework. While this represents a long-term strategic opportunity for the participating banks, it poses a competitive threat to Circle Internet Group's USDC stablecoin, which currently dominates the market with $73.3B in circulation.
